versions.content: At a call to Com_SendDynSignal, the AUTOSAR COM module shall set the length of the corresponding dynamic length I-PDU to the smallest length that includes the dynamic length signal. The length of the dynamic signal shall be equal to the value of input parameter “Length” passed in the API Com_SendDynSignal.
